_specs: The design name comes from the Shopify image filename, the only record of what the print is. Nothing about the artwork is invented.
buyBody: Gold flecked across the shirt like it was thrown at it. The loudest print in the Classic range and the one that most obviously belongs to a brand whose clubs are gold.
pieceHeadline: The one that matches the wedge
pieceParas: A gold paint-splatter across the body. It is not subtle and it is not trying to be — this is the shirt for the golfer who already owns a gold wedge and would like the two to be obviously related.
The splatter is irregular, so no two areas of the shirt read the same, which stops it looking like uniform.
lifestyleBrief: Portrait 4:5, on body, with a gold club in frame. The whole shot is the rhyme between the flecks and the finish on the club. There is no on-body apparel photography at all yet (HANDOFF §7b F).
